title: Vietnamese Chicken Pho
description: A classic Vietnamese noodle soup made with chicken, vegetables, and fragrant spices. This recipe serves 4 and can be prepared in under an hour.
instructions: Combine chicken and pho spice mix in a bowl. Set aside.
Heat ga broth in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add onion and ginger to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add chicken to the pot and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add rice noodles to the pot and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
Remove chicken from the pot and shred into bite-sized pieces.
Return chicken to the pot and stir in bean sprouts.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and lime wedges.
